sections.markdown:
## F — Structured research index and consolidated VERIFY list: stopping rules, special vehicles, headlights, parking and phones
Knowledge facts: part C holds 41 fact blocks (sec07-F01 onward) from physical pages 76 to 89; part C2 holds 27 confusable and continuation blocks (sec07-R01 onward).
Exam authority: part A states the issuer, the 2026 manual, the 50-question count and the 80 percent (40 of 50) passing standard from physical pages 32 and 33; the time limit is unknown.
VERIFY list:
- NJ-STOP-A-TIME — knowledge-test time limit not printed in the manual (owner EvidenceLibrarian, official tier).
- NJ-STOP-D-BLANK — two image-only pages inside the stopping regulations chapter (owner EvidenceLibrarian).
- NJ-STOP-MARKET — market pack unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
- NJ-STOP-TEARDOWN — competitive teardown unresearched (owner SMEResearchAgent).
Dynamic facts: Move Over, phone and littering fines and points (for example sec07-F21, sec07-F39) can change and must be refreshed from the MVC website.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
